context.transcript:
Hi, Mr. Olson.
I'm Eun-hee Sohn from Circle Optical Supplies.
I'm calling about the order you placed yesterday.
Oh, yes.
I ordered supplies for my eyeglass store.
Is there an issue?
Well, we only have 25 of the eyeglass cases you ordered.
Unfortunately, we won't have any more in stock for another two weeks.
Oh, no.
We have a promotional event starting next Friday, and we usually provide a case with each pair of eyeglasses our customers purchase.
Hmm.
I guess I'll take the 25 cases you have, but I'll have to order the rest from another company.
Okay, I'll update your order.
And as an apology, my manager told me to waive your delivery charge, so we'll cover the $20 shipping fee.
context.transcript_translation:
Hi, Mr. Olson.
我是来自 Circle Optical Supplies 的 Eun-hee Sohn。
我打电话是关于您昨天下的订单的。
哦，是的。
我订购了用于我的眼镜店的用品。
有什么问题吗？
嗯，我们只剩下您订购的 25 个眼镜盒。
很遗憾，在接下来的两周内我们不会再有库存了。
哦，不。
我们下周五开始有一个促销活动，通常我们会为顾客购买的每一副眼镜提供一个盒子。
嗯。
我想我接受您现有的 25 个盒子，但我得从另一家公司订购剩下的部分。
好的，我会更新您的订单。
作为道歉，我的经理让我免除您的送货费，所以我们将承担 $20 的运费。
